messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-01-22] incident-review/INC-2026-003: Incident review INC-2026-003. Webhooks delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. Root cause: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
- [2026-05-08] incident-review/INC-2026-009: INC-2026-009 review. What happened: scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. Why: two leaders elected during a network partition. Follow-up decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2025-11-17] handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction: The 2025-11-07 note about the reporting service named the wrong team. The Ember team took it over on that date; team Boreal did not.
- [2025-03-19] standup/ember/2025-03-19: Deploys to the scheduler happen on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2025-04-28] incident-review/INC-2025-011: INC-2025-011 review. What happened: the ledger service saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-26. Why: an index missing after the schema migration. Follow-up decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2026-03-19] standup/ember/2026-03-19: No deploys to the ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close.
- [2026-03-12] standup/boreal/2026-03-12: For anything Boreal-related, page Lena.
- [2026-06-16] standup/ember/2026-06-16: The weekly architecture review is run by Oskar.
- [2026-03-04] standup/dune/2026-03-04: The webhook dispatcher remains a team Dune service.
- [2026-06-08] standup/dune/2026-06-08: Rotation day for Dune: Tomasz hands the pager to Farah.
- [2026-05-25] standup/atlas/2026-05-25: Marcus picked up the Atlas on-call shift from Priya today.
- [2026-04-23] standup/atlas/2026-04-23: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2026-02-19] standup/boreal/2026-02-19-2: Lena has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2026-02-10] handover/2026-02-10-reporting: The reports pipeline has a new home: the Cinder team. Ember kept it until today.
- [2026-05-18] standup/ember/2026-05-18: Oskar Lind picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego today.
- [2026-06-18] standup/ember/2026-06-18: Team Ember on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-04-13] standup/dune/2026-04-13: On-call rotation: Tomasz is primary for Dune starting today; Farah is off rotation.
- [2026-03-10] standup/dune/2026-03-10: On-call rotation: Farah is primary for Dune starting today; Tomasz Nowak is off rotation.
- [2026-03-09] standup/atlas/2026-03-09-2: Observation from Atlas: after the runtime upgrade, the scheduler's cold start time tripled.
- [2026-02-23] standup/dune/2026-02-23: The job scheduler deploy window (unchanged): on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.
- [2026-02-19] standup/boreal/2026-02-19: As of today Marcus Oyelaran is on the Atlas team; team Boreal loses a pair of hands.
- [2026-02-04] standup/dune/2026-02-04: Team Dune on-call swapped this morning. Tomasz Nowak carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-05-26] handover/2026-05-26-billing-api: Ownership change: billing-api now sits with the Dune team. Boreal no longer owns it.
- [2026-03-09] standup/atlas/2026-03-09: On-call rotation: Marcus Oyelaran is primary for team Atlas starting today; Priya is off rotation.
- [2026-03-03] standup/dune/2026-03-03: Image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only. Rationale: storage for originals doubled in six months.
- [2026-02-04] standup/dune/2026-02-04-2: As before, the webhook dispatcher needs the event bus to work. Reminder: webhooks is owned by team Dune.
- [2026-01-15] standup/ember/2026-01-15: For newcomers: the deploy window for the ledger service is still on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2026-01-05] standup/cinder/2026-01-05: Observation from the Cinder team: after the retention change, Ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2026-02-24] handover/2026-02-24-feature-flags: Quick one: the flags service belongs to the Cinder team starting today. Thanks to the Boreal team for running it until now.
- [2026-01-13] standup/atlas/2026-01-13: The Atlas team noticed that Ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2026-01-22] standup/atlas/2026-01-22: Auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. Rationale: the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.
